# Video V-02: Read the confirmation view at the start of the day

## Script

Say: "This is how the operations manager does this, at the start of each day." [SC-11]

1. Show and say: "Open the confirmation view." [SC-11 step 1]
2. Show and say: "Check which of yesterday's orders were confirmed to the customer." [SC-11 step 2]
